'''Derrin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] mercenary and a non-[[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] member of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].

==Biography==
In [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], Derrin fled from the [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]] after the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] managed to break through the Brotherhood's defenses, and returned to the Sith camp. He and his friends were lucky enough to survive the [[thought bomb]]'s effect, which had been the reason for the destruction of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], because they were not force-sensitive. While scavenging treasures and supplies, Derrin and the group were attacked by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] who returned to the camp. He was killed, along with [[Rell (mercenary)|Rell]] and [[Pad]], as they stood guard at the Sith camp by a direct [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strike to the body. However, Bane let their comrades [[Lergan]] and [[Hansh]] live.
